"""Reproduce the powerlift trajectory for /app/instance.npz."""
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from rcb_hb import Session

INSTANCE = '/app/instance.npz'
OUT = Path('/app/output')

def normalized_targets(s, targets):
    lo, hi = s.low.model.actuator_ctrlrange.T
    return np.clip((2.0 * targets - lo - hi) / (hi - lo), -1, 1)

def generate(s):
    q = s.low.data.qpos.copy()
    target = np.zeros(s.nu)
    # Body servos track the initial standing pose.
    for i in range(21):
        adr = s.low.model.joint(s.low.model.actuator(i).trnid[0]).qposadr[0]
        target[i] = q[adr]
    # Keep both Shadow hands relaxed at zero joint/tendon command.
    target[21:] = 0.0
    a = normalized_targets(s, target)
    return np.tile(a, (s.max_steps, 1))

if __name__ == '__main__':
    s = Session('powerlift', instance=INSTANCE)
    s.reset()
    actions = generate(s)
    s.save_trajectory(actions, OUT / 'trajectory.npz', meta={'approach':'initial-pose hold'})
    print('saved', actions.shape, 'initial-pose hold')
